page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance generally operates in the lower tiers for compute-heavy tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests falls within the bottom 25% or bottom 10% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show a mixed profile, with read-only operations ranking in the bottom 25%, while large-block write operations achieve average performance. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip compression, also show lower-tier throughput. However, Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests register average performance, and small-model LLM inference speeds remain in the middle 50% tier.

Given the high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU combined with modest CPU performance, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency compute power. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications with large memory footprints, and memory-bound data processing tasks where raw CPU throughput is not the primary bottleneck.
